mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT kb.id, kb.name, kb.description, kb.user_id, kb.embedding_model_id, kb.document_count, kb.chunk_count, kb.status, kb.security_label_id, kb.create_time, kb.update_time, kb.del_flag FROM knowledge_base kb LEFT JOIN knowledge_base_dept kbd ON kb.id = kbd.knowledge_base_id LEFT JOIN knowledge_security_label ksl ON kb.security_label_id = ksl.id WHERE kb.del_flag = 0 AND ( kb.user_id = #{userId} OR ( kbd.dept_id IN ( SELECT sud.dept_id FROM sys_user_dept sud WHERE sud.user_id = #{userId} ) AND (ksl.label_level IS NULL OR ksl.label_level <= ( SELECT MAX(ksl2.label_level) FROM sys_user_role sur JOIN sys_role sr ON sur.role_id = sr.id JOIN knowledge_security_label ksl2 ON sr.security_label_id = ksl2.id WHERE sur.user_id = #{userId} )) ) ) ORDER BY kb.create_time DESC
